fetchable_endpoint.url: https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/{slug}  (slugs seen 2026-10-12: nfl26, mlb, nba, nhl, college-football, soccer, formula-1, nascar, canadian-football-league; hub https://www.siriusxm.com/sports also links nfl, mens-college-basketball, womens-college-basketball, college-baseball, college-softball, indycar, pga-tour)
fetchable_endpoint.method: Plain HTTPS GET with a browser User-Agent. No login, no API key. Returns HTML (250-725 KB). It is NOT a JSON API: per-game data is embedded in the Next.js RSC payload (self.__next_f.push strings). Unescape the \" sequences, then brace-match each object containing "gameID" (team sports, F1) or "raceID" (NASCAR). json.loads works on each object.
fetchable_endpoint.fields: Team games: gameID, gameDate, endDateTime, homeLeagueAbbreviation (NFL/MLB/NBA/NHL/NCAAF/EPL/UCL/MLS/USL/INTL/CFL), homeTeamCity, awayTeamCity, homeTeamAbbreviation, awayTeamAbbreviation, homeStream, awayStream (satellite/radio channel), homeInternetStream, awayInternetStream (app channel), nationalStream, nationalInternetStream, spanishStream, spanishInternetStream, homeStreamLink/awayStreamLink/nationalStreamLink/spanishStreamLink (sxm.app.link deep links), tbdTime, home/awayConfernceAbbreviation (sic; college only: SEC, BIG10, ACC, BIG12, AAC...). F1: gameID, eventName, gameDate, gameEndDate, venueName, nationalStream, nationalInternetStream, nationalStreamLink. NASCAR: raceID, raceOrDriverName, seriesName, seriesKey, startDateTime, venueOrTeamName, nationalStream, nationalStreamLink. Missing values are the literal string "$undefined".
fetchable_endpoint.coverage: Rolling ~7-day window per league page. 2026-10-12 pull: NFL 15 games (10/12-10/19), MLB 11 (LCS, 10/13-10/20), NHL 62, NBA 26, NCAAF 61, soccer 18, CFL 4, F1 30 sessions (to 12/06), NASCAR 15 races (to 11/08). The /sports hub shows only 1 game per league.
fetchable_endpoint.notes: Channel numbers are reassigned per game and day (NFL team feeds rotate 192-200 / 261-268), so scrape daily and do not hardcode them. The page defaults to the 'Streaming & Most Radios' lineup. The NFL slug is season-specific (nfl26), so discover slugs from the hub's /sports/ links each run. api.edge-gateway.siriusxm.com appears in the page config only as a base URL; no public unauthenticated per-game JSON endpoint was found. Reminder calendars are linked at https://siriusxm.roktcalendar.com/{nfl,nba,nascar,f1,pga,indycar} (not tested). There were transient DNS failures during testing, so add retries.
